next.reason: The 1985 rule only makes the relative SAME clause the sequential one. 2023 has one SAME clause in I-O-CONTROL and §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR4 'The files specified in a given SAME clause need not all have the same organization or access'. SR7 states the clause's own per-format limits (the sequential SAME rule's content), not this sameness.
